sentences: You've never seen your real face.
Not the way everyone else sees it.
Every mirror flips you left to right.
And almost every face is a little lopsided.
So the face you know... [whispers] is backwards.
In 1977, scientists showed people their real face and a flipped one.
Their friends? [laughs] Picked the real one.
We like the face we see most.
Another study? People picked a prettier, edited version as their real face.
So that photo you can't stand? [gasps] That's the face your friends prefer.
